role: Builds .venv-codemap for the code map: picks a Python 3.10+ interpreter (tree-sitter 0.26 needs it; macOS's own python3 is 3.9), and when none is installed fetches a pinned, checksum-verified standalone CPython 3.12.7 into .codemap-python/; recreates the venv with it (--clear, so a venv an older interpreter made is rebuilt) and installs scripts/codemap/requirements.txt with hashes required. Run by `make codemap-setup` when the venv is missing or cannot import tree-sitter.
state: file:.codemap-python/ (standalone CPython, unpacked when no 3.10+ is installed)
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to the repo root. Defines STANDALONE_RELEASE=20241016, STANDALONE_VERSION=3.12.7, STANDALONE_DIR=.codemap-python. Takes python_for_codemap's interpreter, else standalone_python's. With neither: prints where it looked, that the standalone build could not be fetched, which python3 was found and how to supply one, exit 1. Otherwise: python -m venv --clear .venv-codemap, pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes -r scripts/codemap/requirements.txt, prints the interpreter version used.

units.does: Prints, one per line, the paths where Python 3.10-3.13 is usually installed without being on PATH: /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin (Homebrew), $HOME/.pyenv/shims (pyenv) as pythonX.Y, and /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/X.Y/bin/python3 (python.org installer). Nothing is checked here; python_for_codemap tries each.

Prints the first interpreter that is Python 3.10 or newer among CODEMAP_BASE_PYTHON (when set), python3.13, python3.12, python3.11, python3.10 and python3 on PATH, then the usual off-PATH install locations (installed_pythons), and returns 0; returns 1 when none is.

branches.cond: candidate empty or not on PATH

units.does: Prints the pinned SHA-256 of the python-build-standalone CPython 3.12.7 (release 20241016) install_only archive for the given platform triple (aarch64/x86_64 apple-darwin, aarch64/x86_64 unknown-linux-gnu), taken from the release's SHA256SUMS; returns 1 for any other triple.

branches.cond: one of the four pinned triples

units.does: Maps uname -m (arm64/aarch64 → aarch64, x86_64) and uname -s (Darwin → apple-darwin, Linux → unknown-linux-gnu) to the python-build-standalone platform triple and prints it; returns 1 for any other architecture or OS.
Prints the hex SHA-256 of the file given: shasum -a 256 when it exists (macOS), otherwise sha256sum (Linux).

Prints the path of the standalone interpreter .codemap-python/python/bin/python3. If it is already unpacked, prints it and returns 0. Otherwise works out the platform (standalone_platform) and its pinned checksum (standalone_sha256), downloads the matching install_only archive from the python-build-standalone GitHub release into a mktemp file with curl (3 retries), compares its SHA-256 (file_sha256) with the pinned one, replaces .codemap-python with the unpacked archive and prints the interpreter. Every failure removes the temp archive and returns 1.

branches.cond: checksum differs from the pinned one
branches.effect: prints that it is not used; temp removed; return 1 (nothing unpacked)

branches.cond: tar fails or the interpreter is not there after unpacking
